scope: Three generated synthetic Commerce Demo policy PDFs, all nine pages, processed with the upload DocumentProcessor path.
reference_method: Extracted text from temporary native-text PDFs rendered from the exact policy generator content before image-only rasterization; normalized with scripts/processing/evaluate_ocr.py::normalize.
conclusion: The currently configured page OCR (PSM 11, scale 1.5) had the lowest aggregate CER on these nine synthetic policy pages. Keep the current setting for this evidence; do not treat the result as a real-scan benchmark or a general OCR-model comparison.
limitations: These image-only PDFs were digitally composed and rasterized; no physical scanner, camera, skew, blur, or variable paper condition was represented in this policy subset.
The source policy content was authored by the project and is fictional. This measures transcription of this fixed synthetic layout only.
Per-page CER is rounded to five decimal places; the aggregate was computed from unrounded edit counts and reference lengths.
The three PDFs contain no tables, so this check does not evaluate scanned-table structure or cell accuracy.
